patch_description:
This crossover combines the efficiency of the single-source Dijkstra pre-computation from the prior program with a per-partition multipath strategy. Key improvements:
1. Compute single-source Dijkstra once instead of per-destination, reducing routing overhead.
2. For each partition, draw from the generator of k-shortest simple paths so different partitions can traverse different (parallel) routes, spreading load across networks and avoiding bottleneck links.
3. Dedupe shared edges within a partition's path to avoid redundant transfer records.
4. Fall back safely to Dijkstra paths when a destination is unreachable or k-shortest iteration fails, preserving the original program's robustness and identical output format.
